family: N10 cash-and-carry of fixed-expiry BTCUSDT USD-M future versus BTCUSDT spot
distinctFromN2: Uses dated-future basis convergence and no periodic perpetual funding payments; one economic family regardless of contract quarter.

source.spot: Existing verified Binance spot BTCUSDT H1 research/cache/v3/BTCUSDT-1h.json
source.datedTrade: Binance Vision USD-M monthly klines/BTCUSDT_YYMMDD/1h, discovered in official S3 listing and checksum verified
source.datedMark: Binance Vision USD-M monthly markPriceKlines/BTCUSDT_YYMMDD/1h, discovered in official S3 listing and checksum verified
source.expiry: YYMMDD contract code, 08:00 UTC on expiry day as stated in Binance USD-M Delivery Futures Contracts Specification
source.marketCaveat: Binance USDT spot and Binance USD-M dated futures, not The5ers/MT5 contract or executable bid/ask prices

universe: BTC only; choose nearest fixed expiry with 21 <= calendar days to expiry <= 60 at each closed H1 decision, never a perpetual
clock: The H1 bar with open t becomes known at t+1h; choose and evaluate using only spot/dated trade H1 closes at t. Entry requires the joint spot/dated trade/mark H1 open exactly at t+1h; if absent, the signal is an uncertain unexecutable candidate, not a clean entry. Exit uses the first joint open at or after its causal trigger. No invented bar or fill.

entry.annualizedBasis: (F_close/S_close - 1) * 365 / days_to_expiry at the closed H1 timestamp
entry.reentry: No reentry at exit open; earliest next H1 open with a fresh completed-hour decision

positionIfSamplePasses.hedge: Buy spot and short identical BTC quantity of dated future at next joint open
positionIfSamplePasses.cash: Remaining USD margin; no borrowing assumed for sample count; actual capital cost and margin tiers are unpriced

exit.time: At D-7 days, using known 08:00 UTC expiry; first joint open at or after that timestamp; this calendar exit does not require a fresh H1 close
exit.priceCondition: Use only a completed H1 close; exit next joint open
exit.gap: An active episode with absent joint H1 data or delayed exit is flagged uncertain; no interpolation or PnL

sampleOnly.decision: Count qualifying completed decisions and clean entry/exit episodes; calculate no PnL, returns, PF, fees paid, drawdown or stress trade paths. If clean closed episodes <100, report insufficient observable sample in this snapshot and stop without building a full execution engine or opening validation/recent windows; gaps can hide other episodes, so this is not a mathematical cap on history.
sampleOnly.unclosedAndGapEpisodes: Report separately, never add to clean closed episodes

approval: Bid/ask, historical margin tiers, financing/capital cost and venue contract equivalence are absent; no sample count can approve an operational strategy.
